title: Extensionality of positive-line maps on compatible ordered frame generators
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], a k-scheme T, its signed finite coefficient sheaves [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data] and coherent frames [def-pur-finite-signed-twist-products]. Let e1 be any isomorphism from the first signed ordinary sheaf to the coefficient unit, d a natural number, M any coefficient-module sheaf, and f,g maps from the d-th signed ordinary sheaf to M. Suppose that for every site object V and coherent signed frame b, ordinary sections x1,x realizing b(1),b(d), with e1(x1) equal to coefficient one, satisfy f(x)=g(x). Then f=g. No isomorphism hypothesis on f or g, and no normalization or existence assertion about a family of charts, is included.

source.place: Step 2, compatibility with the invertible twist by associativity of derived tensor; expanded Step 8 of def-pur-finite-positive-root-charts.

proof.text: Use the inverse e1 on coefficient one as the degree-one generator. On a pro-etale trivializing cover extend it to all positive ordered tensor powers, the coefficient-one zero vector, and the dual evaluation bases. This gives a coherent signed frame. The realization unit/counit identify ordinary and intrinsic section modules, so these frame vectors have ordinary representatives. The construction works at degree zero and on the empty object.

The assumed equality gives equality on the degree-d frame generator. Transport the maps to intrinsic coefficient modules, where linearity over the coefficient ring sheaf extends this equality to every local section. Equivalently, apply basis extensionality in a trivialization. The target sheaf is separated, so equality after restriction to a covering implies equality on each original section. Sheaf morphism extensionality yields f=g.

proof_origin.place: Explicit ordinary-sheaf realization of the positive-power construction in Step 2.

theorem finiteTensorPositiveChart_frame_ext (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (e₁ : P.finiteTensorFixedSheaf T 1 ≅
      𝟙_ (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))
    (d : ℕ) (M : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient))
    (f g : P.finiteTensorFixedSheaf T d ⟶ M)
    (h : ∀ (V : T.ProEt) (b : P.FiniteTensorFrame T V)
      (x₁ : (P.finiteTensorFixedSheaf T 1).obj.obj (Opposite.op V))
      (x : (P.finiteTensorFixedSheaf T d).obj.obj (Opposite.op V)),
      HEq (P.finiteTensorSection T 1 V x₁) (P.finiteTensorFrameBasis T V b 1) →
      e₁.hom.hom.app (Opposite.op V) x₁ =
        (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (sheafToPresheaf (ProEt.topology T)
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient))).app (Opposite.op V) (1 : P.Coefficient) →
      HEq (P.finiteTensorSection T d V x) (P.finiteTensorFrameBasis T V b d) →
      f.hom.app (Opposite.op V) x = g.hom.app (Opposite.op V) x) : f = g
